info.title: CosmicForge RTC API
info.description: CF Meet Meeting Service. `/api/v1`: legacy meeting API (retained for compatibility). `/api/v2`: Phase 2 meeting domain (MeetingSpace → ConferenceSession → ConferenceParticipant → ParticipantSession). v2 errors use `{ success:false, error:{ code, message, requestId } }` with stable semantic codes.

get.summary: Root endpoint - Application information
get.description:
Returns a brief description of the CosmicForge RTC application,
including its purpose, key features, and available endpoints.

get.summary: List session logs (admin only)
get.description:
Paged meeting session event log, most recent event first (`page` from 1, `limit` 1–100,
default 20), optionally filtered by `meeting_id` and `event_type`. Requires the admin role.

get.summary: List all meetings (admin only)
get.description:
Paged list of every legacy meeting, newest first (`page` from 1, `limit` 1–100, default 20),
optionally filtered by `status` and `host_id`. Requires the admin role.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status: scheduled, ongoing, ended, cancelled

get.summary: List all users (admin only)
get.description:
Paged list of every user account, newest first (`page` from 1, `limit` 1–100, default 20),
optionally filtered by `status` and `role`. Requires the admin role.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status: pending_verification, active, inactive

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: Filter by role: user, admin, guest

patch.description:
Changes a user's `role` and/or `status`; omitted fields are left unchanged. An admin cannot
change their own role. Requires the admin role.

403.description: Forbidden - Admin access required or cannot modify own role

get.summary: List all API keys for the authenticated user
get.description:
Returns every API key owned by the authenticated user, both active and revoked, newest first.
Key values are masked to their last four characters; usage count, usage limit, expiry and status
are included. Not paginated.

post.summary: Create a new API key
post.description:
Generates a new API key owned by the authenticated user. The request body currently takes no
fields: every key gets a usage limit of 100 requests and expires 20 days after creation. The
full key value is returned only in this response (later reads show it masked), so store it now.
Send it in the `Api-Key` header on endpoints that accept API-key authentication.

get.summary: Get a specific API key by ID
get.description:
Returns one API key owned by the authenticated user, with the key value masked to its last four
characters, plus its usage count, usage limit, expiry and status. Returns 404 if the key does
not exist or belongs to another user.

delete.description:
Marks an API key owned by the authenticated user as revoked so it can no longer authenticate
requests. The key is not deleted: it stays in the list with status `revoked`. Revoking a key
that is already revoked returns 409.

post.summary: Create a new meeting via API key
post.description:
Third-party integrations can use this endpoint with Api-Key authentication
to create meetings on behalf of the key owner.

403.description: Forbidden - API key usage limit exceeded

post.summary: Join a meeting via API key
post.description:
Third-party integrations can use this endpoint with Api-Key authentication
to join meetings. The user associated with the API key is used for authentication.

403.description: Forbidden - API key usage limit exceeded or private meeting

409.description: Meeting has ended, cancelled, too early to join, or past scheduled end time

post.summary: Change password for authenticated user
post.description:
Changes the signed-in user's password after checking `current_password`. Requires a bearer
access token. `new_password` must be 8-128 characters and match `confirm_password`. Returns 400
if the current password is wrong or the account uses Google sign-in. A change signs the account
out of every session, including the current one; sign in again with the new password.

400.description: Invalid current password or validation error

post.summary: Request password reset
post.description:
Starts a password reset by emailing a 6-digit reset code, valid for 1 hour, to an
email-and-password account. Public endpoint. The answer is the same whether or not such an
account exists (no email is sent for unknown or Google sign-in accounts); at most 5 codes per
email are sent within 15 minutes. Finish with `POST /api/v1/auth/reset-password`.

post.summary: Login user
post.description:
Authenticates with email and password and returns an access token (valid 15 minutes), a refresh
token (valid 7 days, rotated on every refresh) and basic user info. Each login opens an account
session that lasts at most 30 days and can be listed and revoked from
`/api/v2/me/sessions`. Public endpoint. Accounts still pending email verification can log in, so
check `user.status` and route to verification if needed; deactivated accounts get 403. More than
5 attempts per email within 15 minutes returns 429; a successful login resets the count.

403.description: Email verification required or account inactive

post.summary: Logout user
post.description:
Ends the current session: the bearer access token is revoked and the session's refresh
token stops working. Tokens issued before account sessions existed cannot be told apart, so
for those this signs the account out everywhere. Other sessions stay signed in; use
`POST /api/v2/me/sessions/revoke-all` to sign out everywhere. When the Messaging integration is
enabled, it also ends the account's Messaging sessions; a Messaging outage does not block
logout.

get.summary: Initiate Google OAuth flow
get.description:
Generates single-use `state` and `nonce` values, binds them to this browser with an HttpOnly
cookie, and redirects the user to Google's consent page. Public endpoint.

303.description: Redirect to Google OAuth consent page

get.summary: Google OAuth callback handler
get.description:
Consumes the single-use state, checks the browser binding, exchanges the authorization code,
validates the ID token (issuer, audience, expiry, nonce, verified email) and signs the user in.
It then redirects to `{APP_URL}/google/callback`. With `GOOGLE_OAUTH_TOKEN_DELIVERY=exchange_code`
the redirect carries only a 60-second single-use `exchange_code` for
`POST /api/v1/auth/oauth/google/exchange`; the legacy mode (tokens in the query string) is kept
only until the live web client adopts the exchange. Errors redirect with a short `error` code.

303.description: Redirect to the web application's Google callback page

post.summary: Exchange a one-time Google sign-in code for tokens
post.description:
Completes Google sign-in when the API runs with `GOOGLE_OAUTH_TOKEN_DELIVERY=exchange_code`.
The code from the callback redirect is valid once, for 60 seconds. Returns the same body as
`POST /api/v1/auth/login`. Public endpoint.

post.summary: Refresh access token
post.description:
Exchanges a valid, unexpired refresh token for a new access token (valid 15 minutes) and a new
refresh token (valid 7 days). Public endpoint: send the refresh token in the request body, not
in the `Authorization` header. Refresh tokens are single-use: presenting a superseded refresh
token ends the whole session. A session lasts at most 30 days from sign-in. Returns 401 if the
token is invalid, expired, revoked or not a refresh token.

post.summary: Register a new user
post.description:
Creates an email-and-password account with the `user` role and `pending_verification` status,
then emails a 6-digit verification code (valid for 24 hours). Public endpoint; no tokens are
returned. Username must be 3-50 letters, digits or underscores and password 8-128 characters.
Email addresses are case-insensitive and stored lowercased. Returns 409 if the email or
username is already in use.

post.summary: Resend verification email
post.description:
Sends a new 6-digit verification code to an account that is still pending verification,
replacing the previous code. Public endpoint. The answer is the same whether or not such an
account exists; at most 5 codes per email are sent within 15 minutes.

post.summary: Reset password with token
post.description:
Sets a new password using the 6-digit code sent by `POST /api/v1/auth/forgot-password`. Public
endpoint. `new_password` must be 8-128 characters and match `confirm_password`. The code is
single-use; repeated wrong codes for the same email are rate-limited (429). A reset signs the
account out of every session.

post.summary: Verify email with token
post.description:
Activates a newly registered account using the 6-digit code emailed at registration. Public
endpoint. The code is single-use; repeated wrong codes for the same email are rate-limited
(429). Returns 400 if the code is wrong or expired; the answer does not reveal whether an
account exists or is already verified.

post.summary: Verify password reset token
post.description:
Checks whether a password reset is pending for the given email, for example before showing the
reset form. Public endpoint. It only confirms that an unexpired reset code exists: the submitted
code must be 6 digits but is not compared or consumed (`POST /api/v1/auth/reset-password` does
that). Returns 400 if no reset is pending, including when the email is unknown.

get.summary: List meetings for the authenticated user
get.description:
Returns meetings hosted by the authenticated user, newest first, with pagination metadata.
Meetings the user only joined as a participant are not included. Use `page` and `limit` to
paginate and `status` to filter (`live` and `ongoing` are equivalent); any other status value
returns a validation error.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status: scheduled, live, ended, cancelled

post.summary: Create a new meeting
post.description:
The authenticated user becomes the host. Meeting starts as "scheduled".
No RTC resources are allocated at this point.

post.summary: Create an instant public meeting
post.description:
Creates a meeting that starts immediately and lasts 1 hour.
The authenticated user becomes the host and is automatically joined.
Returns join token for immediate connection.

post.summary: Join a meeting by meeting identifier (8-character code)
post.description:
This endpoint allows joining using the human-friendly meeting code
instead of the UUID. More convenient for users.

400.description: Validation error - Invalid user_id or display_name

401.description: user_id supplied without a valid access token (identity comes only from the Authorization header)

403.description: Private meeting - guests not allowed, or user_id does not match the authenticated user

409.description: Meeting has ended, cancelled, hasn't started yet, or past scheduled end time

get.summary: Get public meeting info by meeting identifier
get.description:
This endpoint allows the hosted UI to fetch meeting details before joining.
No authentication required. Only returns public information.

get.summary: Get a meeting by ID
get.description:
Returns a meeting hosted by the authenticated user, including its join URL. Only the host can
read a meeting through this endpoint; a meeting hosted by someone else returns 404.

put.description:
Partially updates a meeting hosted by the authenticated user; omitted fields are left unchanged.
Ongoing and ended meetings cannot be edited (409). `start_time` and `end_time` are local times
and require `timezone` (an IANA name); a scheduled meeting's start must be in the future, the
end must be after the start, and the duration may not exceed 24 hours.

409.description: Cannot update ongoing or ended meetings

delete.summary: Delete a meeting (host only, only scheduled meetings)
delete.description:
Permanently deletes a meeting hosted by the authenticated user. Only meetings still in
`scheduled` status can be deleted; any other status returns 409 (end a live meeting with
`POST /api/v1/meetings/{id}/end` instead). Returns 204 with no body.

get.summary: Get chat messages for a meeting

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: ISO 8601 timestamp - only return messages created after this time. Use for incremental loading.

200.description: Chat messages ordered by created_at ascending

403.description: Forbidden - must be a participant or host of this meeting

post.summary: Send a chat message in a meeting

201.description: Message persisted successfully. Now broadcast via LiveKit publishData() for real-time delivery.

400.description: Validation error - message must be 1-2000 characters

403.description: Forbidden - not a joined participant of this meeting

409.description: Conflict - meeting is not live (must be 'ongoing' status)

post.summary: End a meeting (host only)
post.description: Terminates meeting for all participants and triggers session logs.

post.summary: Join a meeting
post.description:
This is where control-plane meets real-time:
1. Validates meeting exists and is not ended
2. Creates a Participant record
3. Assigns role (host or participant)
4. Generates a short-lived LiveKit join token
5. If meeting is scheduled and start time reached, transitions it to live
6. Returns join token to client

400.description: Validation error - Invalid user_id or display_name

401.description: user_id supplied without a valid access token (identity comes only from the Authorization header)

403.description: Private meeting - guests not allowed, or user_id does not match the authenticated user

409.description: Meeting has ended, cancelled, hasn't started yet, or past scheduled end time

get.summary: List all participants in a meeting
get.description:
Returns the participants of a meeting with their role, join and leave times, and audio, video
and screen-share state. People still in the waiting room and those kicked or denied are
excluded. Callable by the meeting host or any user who has a participant record in the meeting;
other users get 403. Not paginated.

post.summary: Start screen sharing
post.description:
Marks the caller as screen sharing in the meeting and logs the event. The caller must be a
registered user who has joined the meeting (404 otherwise). Only one participant can share at a
time: returns 409 if the caller or another participant is already sharing.

409.description: Already screen sharing or another participant is sharing

post.summary: Stop screen sharing
post.description:
Clears the caller's screen-sharing flag in the meeting and logs the event. The caller must be a
registered user who has joined the meeting (404 otherwise); returns 409 if they are not
currently sharing. It only stops the caller's own share.

get.summary: List participants in the waiting room
get.description:
Returns the participants waiting to be admitted to a meeting, with their display name and when
they joined the waiting room. Only the meeting host may call this. Not paginated.

403.description: Only host can view waiting room

post.summary: Admit a participant from the waiting room (host only)
post.description:
Admits a participant from the waiting room, changing their status to joined, and logs the event.
Only the meeting host may call this. The participant must belong to this meeting (404 otherwise)
and must currently be waiting (409 otherwise).

409.description: Participant is not in waiting room

post.summary: Deny a participant from the waiting room (host only)
post.description:
Rejects a participant in the waiting room: they are marked as kicked with a leave time, and the
event is logged. Only the meeting host may call this. The participant must belong to this
meeting (404 otherwise) and must currently be waiting (409 otherwise).

409.description: Participant is not in waiting room

patch.description:
Sets a participant's recorded mute state from `is_muted` and logs the change; it updates the
meeting's stored state and does not itself mute the media track. Users may update their own
participant record and the meeting host may update anyone's; a guest token may update only its
own participant. Returns the participant's current audio, video and screen-share state.

403.description: Can only control your own media or host can control any

post.summary: Kick a participant from the meeting (host only)
post.description:
Marks a participant as kicked, records their leave time and logs the event; they no longer
appear in the participant list. Only the host of the participant's meeting may call this, and
the host cannot be kicked (409).

patch.description:
Sets a participant's recorded camera state from `is_video_on` and logs the change; it updates
the meeting's stored state and does not itself turn the camera on or off. Users may update their
own participant record and the meeting host may update anyone's; a guest token may update only
its own participant. Returns the participant's current audio, video and screen-share state.

403.description: Can only control your own media or host can control any

get.summary: Get current authenticated user's information
get.description:
Returns the full user profile for the authenticated user.
Requires authentication via JWT token. `status` is `pending_verification`, `active`,
`inactive` or `suspended`; until `ACCOUNT_STATUS_FORMAT=canonical` is set the unverified
state is spelled `pendingverification` (historical v1 value). The full profile (display
name, avatar, time zone, locale) is `GET /api/v2/me/profile`.

patch.description:
Allows users to update their username (3-50 letters, digits or underscores after
surrounding spaces are removed: the registration rule). Email, role, status, and password
cannot be updated through this endpoint. Display name, avatar, time zone and locale are
changed with `PATCH /api/v2/me/profile`.

400.description: Validation error or no fields to update

post.summary: Deactivate current user's account (soft delete)
post.description:
Sets the user's status to Inactive. This immediately invalidates all existing
tokens as the auth middleware checks user status on every request.
This operation is idempotent - calling it multiple times has the same effect.

get.summary: List all webhooks for the authenticated user
get.description:
Returns all webhooks owned by the authenticated user, active and inactive, newest first. Secrets
are not included. Not paginated.

post.summary: Create a new webhook
post.description:
Registers a webhook for one event type (`meeting_start`, `meeting_end`, `participant_join` or
`participant_leave`), owned by the authenticated user and active from creation. Create one
webhook per event type you need. The response includes a generated secret, which is returned
only here and never by the list or update endpoints.

delete.description:
Permanently deletes a webhook owned by the authenticated user. Returns 404 if the webhook does
not exist or belongs to another user. To disable a webhook without deleting it, set its status
to `inactive` with `PATCH /api/v1/webhooks/{id}`.

patch.description:
Changes the endpoint URL and/or status (`active` or `inactive`) of a webhook owned by the
authenticated user; omitted fields are left unchanged. The event type cannot be changed, so
create a new webhook instead. Returns 404 if the webhook does not exist or belongs to another
user.

get.summary: Read the account security audit (platform administrators)
get.description:
Append-only account security events — sign-ins, sign-outs, password changes and resets,
Google linking, refresh-token reuse — newest first. Requires a platform administrator.
Events never contain passwords, tokens, email addresses or network addresses.

parameters.name: eventType
parameters.description: Exact event type, for example LOGIN, LOGOUT_ALL or REFRESH_TOKEN_REUSE.

get.summary: Chat migration state, gates and evidence.
get.description:
Returns the current meeting-chat migration state (LEGACY_PRIMARY, SHADOW_VALIDATION,
MESSAGING_PRIMARY or LEGACY_RETIRED) and its version, the 20 most recent transitions, counts of
messages still to mirror or copy back and of pending session revocations, the number of linked
conferences and the latest parity run. Platform administrators only; returns FEATURE_DISABLED
when the Messaging integration is not enabled.

post.summary: Run a shadow-validation parity check now.
post.description:
Runs a parity check immediately, comparing the legacy chat history of every linked conference
(main room, breakout rooms and private chats) with Messaging, records the run and returns it
with the numbers of conferences and messages checked and mismatches found. The run is PASSED
only when nothing differs; cutover to MESSAGING_PRIMARY requires a recent PASSED run. Platform
administrators only.

post.summary: Request a migration transition (gated, version-checked, audited).
post.description:
Moves the meeting-chat migration to `targetState`; platform administrators only.
`expectedVersion` must equal the current version (MEETING_VERSION_CONFLICT otherwise) and
`reason` (3–500 characters) is recorded with the transition. Allowed steps are LEGACY_PRIMARY ↔
SHADOW_VALIDATION ↔ MESSAGING_PRIMARY → LEGACY_RETIRED, and gates are enforced: cutover to
MESSAGING_PRIMARY needs a different operator in `approvedBy`, no messages left to mirror and a
PASSED parity run newer than the current shadow period; LEGACY_RETIRED also needs `approvedBy`;
returning to LEGACY_PRIMARY needs every message copied back. A refused step returns
CHAT_MIGRATION_REFUSED; on success the new status is returned.

post.summary: Run the idempotent legacy → v2 backfill and return migration evidence.

get.summary: Compare legacy and v2 state for one legacy meeting (no mutation).
get.description:
Reports the v2 meeting space the legacy meeting maps to, whether both representations are
consistent, and every difference found. Read-only; requires a platform administrator.

get.summary: List all business organizations (platform administrators).
get.description:
Returns every first-party organization in id order (`cursor` = the previous page's
`nextCursor`; `limit` 1–200, default 50), optionally filtered by `status` (ACTIVE, SUSPENDED or
ARCHIVED). Requires a platform administrator bearer token. Returns FEATURE_DISABLED until the
Organizations Service is authoritative.

post.summary: Create an organization (platform administrators).
post.description:
Creates an ACTIVE organization with a unique `slug` (lowercase letters, digits and `-`) and a
name of 1–200 characters, optionally making `ownerUserId` its first OWNER. Requires a platform
administrator bearer token. Once the Organizations Service is authoritative this is relayed to
its operator create (creation source PLATFORM_ADMIN, the administrator recorded as creator)
and the response keeps this shape.

patch.summary: Suspend or reactivate an organization (platform administrators).
patch.description:
Sets the organization's status to ACTIVE or SUSPENDED. While an organization is suspended, its
own OWNERs and ADMINs can no longer list or manage its members. Requires a platform
administrator bearer token. Once the Organizations Service is authoritative this is relayed to
its operator lifecycle change and the response keeps this shape.

get.summary: Read a conference. Callers without authority get the SUMMARY view.
get.description:
Works with or without authentication. The space owner, members and admitted participants get the
FULL view (schedule, lock, recording/transcription state, version); anyone else gets the SUMMARY
view with the id, meeting space id, status and — except for HEALTHCARE / HIGH_SECURITY /
healthcare-appointment meetings — the scheduled start and end (pre-join countdown).

get.summary: Artefacts of a conference (historical access still requires authorization).
get.description:
Lists the conference's artifacts (recordings, transcripts, reports and other outputs), newest
first, at most 200. Requires the artifact-list permission; transcripts and caption tracks are
omitted unless the caller may also read transcripts. Filter by type with `artifactType`.

post.summary: Generate an attendance report, poll report or chat export (policy-gated).
post.description:
Builds an `ATTENDANCE_REPORT`, `POLL_REPORT` or `CHAT_EXPORT` from server-side meeting data and
stores it as a READY JSON artifact. Requires the export permission, and the meeting policy must
allow the requested export type. Anonymous polls stay anonymous and private chat messages are
never exported.

get.summary: One artefact (conference id + artefact id; knowing an id is not authorization).

delete.summary: Delete an artefact (DELETED only after the object's absence is confirmed).
delete.description:
Requests deletion of an artifact and attempts it immediately; if the stored object cannot be
confirmed removed yet, deletion stays pending and is retried automatically. Requires the
artifact-delete permission. A recording must be stopped first, and the meeting policy may forbid
manual deletion of recordings. Repeating the call is safe.

post.summary: Mint a short-lived, read-only, single-object signed URL (never stored).
post.description:
Returns a time-limited, read-only download URL for this one artifact. Requires the artifact-read
permission (plus transcript-read for transcripts and caption tracks), and the artifact must be
READY and not deleted or pending deletion. Each grant is audited; request a new URL once
`expiresAt` has passed.

get.summary: Conference attendance (Part J).
get.description:
A thin read over the same aggregation as the `ATTENDANCE_REPORT` export; nothing is stored
and no artefact is created.

post.summary: Move the caller into the backstage media room (presenters / hosts only).
post.description:
Moves the caller's own admitted participant into the conference's backstage room, separate from
the main stage, creating that room if needed. Requires the backstage permission (owner, host,
co-host, moderator or presenter by default), a meeting profile with backstage enabled, webinar
mode and a LIVE conference. When `credentialRefreshRequired` is true, request a new media
credential (`POST /api/v2/conferences/{id}/media-credential`) to switch rooms; calling it while
already backstage changes nothing. Accepts a bearer user token or a participant token.

200.description: In backstage; refresh the media credential

delete.summary: Leave backstage (return to the main stage room).
delete.description:
Moves the caller's own admitted participant out of the backstage and back to the main stage room
while the conference is LIVE. When `credentialRefreshRequired` is true, request a new media
credential (`POST /api/v2/conferences/{id}/media-credential`); calling it when not backstage
changes nothing. Accepts a bearer user token or a participant token.

200.description: Back on the main stage; refresh the media credential

get.summary: Breakout rooms of a conference (members listed for breakout managers only).
get.description:
Returns the conference's breakout rooms in display order with status and participant count.
Per-room participant ids are included only for callers who may assign participants or enter any
room. `myContext` describes the caller's current media context (main room or a breakout) when
the caller is an admitted participant.

post.summary: Create named or numbered breakout rooms.
post.description:
Creates rooms from either a list of unique `names` or a `count` of automatically numbered rooms
("Room N"), optionally with a per-room `capacity` (1–1000) and recording policy. Rooms start in
CREATED state; open them with the `open` endpoint. Requires the breakout-create permission
(owner, host or co-host by default) and a conference that has not finished; the meeting policy
caps the number of active rooms.

post.summary: Announcement to every open breakout room.
post.description:
Sends a host announcement (1–1000 characters) to participants of every open or closing breakout
room and returns how many rooms received it. Requires the breakout-announce permission and a
live conference, and is rate limited per sender. Fails with `BREAKOUT_CLOSED` when no room is
open.

post.summary: Assign participants (MANUAL, RANDOM or BALANCED).
post.description:
MANUAL (the default when `assignments` is sent) applies an explicit participant-to-room list;
RANDOM and BALANCED (the default otherwise) distribute admitted participants over the target
rooms, by default skipping hosts and anyone already assigned, and return those who could not be
placed. Requires the breakout-assign permission. Closing or closed rooms cannot receive
assignments.

post.summary: Close every breakout of the conference.
post.description:
Closes every breakout room that is not already closed, with the same countdown rules as closing
a single room (`countdownSeconds`, default 60, max 600; 0 = immediate). Participants return to
the main room as each room closes. Requires the breakout-close permission.

post.summary: Leave a breakout visit.
post.description:
Ends the caller's visit to a breakout room and returns them to their own open breakout
assignment, or to the main room if they have none. Requires the enter-any-room permission and a
live conference. Calling it when not visiting returns the current media context unchanged.

200.description: Back in the assigned room or main

post.summary: Move a participant: main → breakout, breakout → breakout, breakout → main.
post.description:
Moves one admitted participant into a breakout room, between rooms, or back to the main room
(`toBreakoutId` null). Requires the breakout-move permission and a live conference; the target
room must not be closing, closed or full. Moving a participant to where they already are is a
no-op (`changed` is false).

post.summary: Announcement to one open breakout room.
post.description:
Sends a host announcement (1–1000 characters) to the participants of this breakout room, which
must be open or closing. Requires the breakout-announce permission and a live conference, and is
rate limited per sender.

patch.summary: Add / remove participants of one breakout room.
patch.description:
Assigns the participants in `add` to this room and returns those in `remove` (if assigned here)
to the main room. Only admitted participants can be added, and adding requires the room to be
neither closing nor closed and to have capacity. Requires the breakout-assign permission.
Returns the updated room.

post.summary: Close one breakout (countdown persisted; 0 = immediate).
post.description:
An open room enters CLOSING for `countdownSeconds` (default 60, max 600), after which its
participants return to the main room; 0 closes it immediately, and a room that was never opened
closes at once. Requires the breakout-close permission. Repeating the call does not restart a
running countdown.

post.summary: Host / co-host enters a breakout room (privileged visit, not an assignment).
post.description:
Moves the caller, who must be an admitted participant with the enter-any-room permission, into
an open breakout room as a visitor. A visit changes no assignments and does not count toward
capacity or balancing. Requires a live conference; end the visit with the `leave` endpoint.

post.summary: Open a breakout room (provider room created, assigned participants rerouted).
post.description:
Opens a CREATED room so its assigned participants are moved into it. Requires the
breakout-create permission and a live conference. Opening a room that is already open returns it
with `changed` false; a closed room cannot be reopened.

get.summary: Export one conference occurrence as an iCalendar (RFC 5545) file.
get.description:
One VEVENT with a stable UID (per occurrence, unchanged by materialization), SEQUENCE that
increases with every change, DTSTART/DTEND in the meeting timezone (TZID + VTIMEZONE; UTC for
UTC meetings; a start-only occurrence lasts 60 minutes) and STATUS:CANCELLED once cancelled.
Allowed for the space owner and members, admitted participants, holders of an active
invitation bound to their verified email, webinar registrants and the owning machine caller;
others get PERMISSION_DENIED. The file carries the meeting link but never a passcode,
invitation token or provider identifier; the title of a HEALTHCARE / HIGH_SECURITY meeting is
replaced unless the caller manages it. Served with `Cache-Control: no-store`.

post.summary: Cancel an unstarted conference (single-occurrence exception for recurring series).
post.description:
Moves a CREATED, PREPARING or WAITING conference to CANCELLED and releases any media room
already prepared. Requires `conference.start`. For an occurrence of a recurring series only that
occurrence is cancelled. Cancelling an already cancelled conference is a no-op
(`changed: false`); live or finished conferences return CONFERENCE_STATE_CONFLICT.

patch.summary: Update the chat subset of the collaboration policy.
patch.description:
Updates any of `chatEnabled`, `chatSendMode`, `privateChatMode`, `breakoutChatEnabled` and
`mainChatVisibleInBreakouts`; omitted fields are left unchanged. Send the `collaborationVersion`
you last read; a stale version returns MEETING_VERSION_CONFLICT. Requires
`conference.configure_live` on a conference that has not ended; returns the full effective
collaboration policy and its new version.

get.summary: Canonical collaboration state.
get.description:
The REST recovery source for media restrictions, spotlight, hand raise, active screen shares
and the caller's media context.

patch.description:
Covers media locks, screen-share policy, chat, reactions, hand raise, Q&A, polls, breakouts
and consents.

post.summary: Record the caller's OWN consent decisions (no participant field exists).
post.description:
Records ACCEPTED or DECLINED decisions for one or more consent types for the caller, who must be
an admitted participant; nobody can decide for another participant. `consentVersion` must match
the current version from the requirements endpoint, otherwise `CONSENT_POLICY_CONFLICT` is
returned. Use the withdraw endpoint to withdraw consent. Returns the updated requirements.

get.summary: The caller's consent requirements (independent types) and current decisions.
get.description:
For each consent type (RECORDING, TRANSCRIPTION, AI_PROCESSING, DATA_SHARING) returns the
meeting policy's consent mode, whether explicit consent is required, whether that processing is
currently active, the current consent version and the caller's own latest decision.
`recordingNotice` is true while a recording is active.

post.summary: Withdraw one consent type (effect follows the profile's withdrawal mode).
post.description:
Withdraws the caller's consent for one type; the caller must be an admitted participant. The
response reports the effect under the meeting's withdrawal mode: recorded only, the active
recording or transcription stopped, or the caller returned to the waiting room. Previously
retained artifacts are not deleted.

post.summary: LIVE → ENDING. Admission and new join credentials stop immediately; ENDED follows provider termination (Part E).
post.description:
Ends a LIVE conference for everyone: active recordings are stopped and the media room is
terminated with the RTC provider. Requires `conference.end`; a conference that never went live
returns CONFERENCE_NOT_LIVE (cancel it instead). Repeating the call while ENDING or ENDED is a
no-op (`changed: false`); while ENDING it retries provider termination. `providerEnforcement`
is ENFORCED once the conference is ENDED.

get.summary: Replay committed conference events after a cursor (recovery without WebSocket).
get.description:
Returns the committed conference events after sequence `after` (default 0) that the caller may
see, plus the cursor to resume from. When the cursor cannot be served (more than 500 events
behind, out of range, or events no longer available) `resyncRequired` is true and the client
must refetch the conference from `GET /api/v2/conferences/{id}`. Same authorization as the
WebSocket.

get.summary: Raised hands, oldest first.
get.description:
Returns the admitted participants whose hand is currently raised, ordered by when they raised
it. Available to admitted participants and to the space owner and members.

post.summary: Raise the caller's own hand.
post.description:
Adds the caller to the raised-hands queue and notifies the conference in realtime. Requires an
admitted participant with `hand.raise` in a LIVE conference with hand raise enabled; rate
limited. Raising an already raised hand returns `changed: false`.

delete.description:
Removes the caller from the raised-hands queue. Requires the caller to be an admitted
participant, and also works after hand raise has been disabled; rate limited. Lowering a hand
that is not raised returns `changed: false`.

post.summary: Request an intelligence output (disabled by default; policy / consent gated).
post.description:
Generates a summary or action items from a READY transcript of this conference and stores the
result as a MEETING_SUMMARY artifact. Requires the feature to be enabled, the
intelligence-request and transcript-read permissions, a meeting policy that permits the
provider's location, and AI-processing consent where policy requires it.

post.summary: Join (or reconnect to) a conference.
post.description:
Identity, role and admission are resolved server-side. A WAITING participant never receives
an RTC credential.

post.summary: Leave: close the caller's own session(s). Admission is unchanged.
post.description:
Disconnects all of the caller's active sessions in the conference, or only the one given in
`participantSessionId`, and returns how many were closed. The caller keeps their admission state
and can join again. Returns PARTICIPANT_NOT_FOUND if the caller has not joined this conference.

post.summary: Lock a live conference: no new non-exempt entrants.
post.description:
While locked, new entrants whose role lacks `participant.admit` are refused with
CONFERENCE_LOCKED; admitted participants can still reconnect and those already waiting keep
waiting. Requires `conference.lock` and a LIVE conference (CONFERENCE_NOT_LIVE otherwise).
Locking an already locked conference is a no-op (`changed: false`).

post.summary: Fresh media credential for the caller's own session.
post.description:
Issued for the session's current context (main room or breakout) with the current effective
grants; used after moves and for refresh.

get.summary: Meeting chat history (database cursor pagination, newest first).
get.description:
Returns one page of messages for `scope`: MAIN (default), BREAKOUT with `breakoutId`, or PRIVATE
with `peerId` (the caller's conversation with that participant). `limit` defaults to 50 (max
100); pass the returned `nextCursor` as `before` to load older messages. Requires `chat.read`;
for non-moderators main chat can be disabled or hidden inside breakouts, and breakout chat is
limited to the caller's own room unless they may enter any breakout.

post.summary: Send a message (sender is always the caller's own participant).
post.description:
Posts a message (1–4000 characters) to the main room, to a breakout room (`breakoutId`, normally
the caller's own) or privately to one admitted participant (`recipientParticipantId`). The
caller must be an admitted participant with `chat.send` (private messages also need
`chat.private`) in a LIVE conference, subject to the chat policy, per-participant restrictions
and rate limits. Moderators (`chat.moderate`) are not blocked by disabled chat and may post
`announcement`s.

delete.summary: Delete / hide a message (moderators, or the sender).
delete.description:
Senders can delete their own messages; moderators with `chat.moderate` can hide main-room and
breakout messages of less privileged participants. Private messages can only be deleted by their
sender and are reported as MESSAGE_NOT_FOUND to anyone outside the conversation. The message
stays in history marked as deleted; repeating the call returns `changed: false`.

get.summary: Admitted participants (roster).
get.description:
Returns the participants currently ADMITTED to the conference, ordered by admission time.
Available to admitted participants and to the space owner and members; other callers (including
waiting, denied, removed or banned participants) get PERMISSION_DENIED.

get.summary: The caller's own participant state (registered user or participant token).
get.description:
Returns the caller's participant record in this conference in whatever admission state it is
(e.g. WAITING, ADMITTED, DENIED), identified by the bearer user token or the participant token
issued at join. Returns PARTICIPANT_NOT_FOUND if the caller has not joined this conference.

post.summary: Lock the participant's microphone (persistent, provider-enforced).
post.description: Stops an admitted participant from publishing their microphone until the lock is removed; the lock is stored on the participant and enforced by the media provider (see `providerEnforcement`). The caller needs the matching media-control permission and may only target a less privileged participant, never themselves. Repeating the call is a no-op that returns `changed: false`.

delete.summary: Unlock the participant's microphone (grants recomputed from role + policy).
delete.description: Removes the lock; the participant's effective publication rights are then recomputed from their role and the conference policy and returned in `permissions`. Same permission and target rules as locking; repeating the call returns `changed: false`.

post.summary: Ban a participant (conference or space scope).
post.description:
Sets the participant to BANNED, disconnects their active sessions and records a ban on their
identity for this conference (default) or the whole meeting space (`scope: SPACE`, also blocks
future occurrences), with optional `reasonCode`, `reason` and future `expiresAt`. Requires
`participant.ban`, and the target must be less privileged than the caller (never yourself).
Idempotent for an already banned participant (no new `banId` is returned).

post.summary: Disable chat for a participant.
post.description:
Prevents the participant from sending chat messages until chat is re-enabled for them. Requires
`chat.moderate`, a target less privileged than the caller (never yourself) and a conference that
has not ended. Idempotent: `changed` is false if chat was already disabled for them.

delete.description:
Lifts a per-participant chat restriction so they can send messages again. Requires
`chat.moderate`, a target less privileged than the caller (never yourself) and a conference that
has not ended. Idempotent: `changed` is false if the participant was not restricted.

Requires `hand.lower_other` and a target less privileged than the caller; targeting yourself
lowers your own hand. Idempotent: `changed` is false if the hand was not raised.

post.summary: Server-side mute of a participant's published tracks.
post.description:
A provider-enforced primitive. Authorization and conference scoping are checked before any
provider call.

post.summary: Remove a participant (business authority; media disconnect enforced by the RTC provider).
post.description:
Sets the participant to REMOVED and disconnects their active media sessions; an optional
`reason` is recorded in the audit log. Requires `participant.remove`, and the target must be
less privileged than the caller (never yourself). Idempotent for participants already removed or
banned; `providerEnforcement` tells whether the RTC provider has confirmed the disconnect.

post.summary: Return an admitted participant to the waiting room.
post.description:
Moves an ADMITTED participant back to WAITING and disconnects their active media sessions; they
must be admitted again to return. Requires `participant.return_to_waiting`, and the target must
be less privileged than the caller (never yourself). Idempotent if the participant is already
waiting; `providerEnforcement` tells whether the RTC provider has confirmed the disconnect.

patch.summary: Change a participant's role (grant authority enforced).
patch.description:
Assigns a new conference role to an ADMITTED or WAITING participant. Requires
`participant.role_change`; the target must be less privileged than the caller, you cannot change
your own or the owner's role, and the new role must be below your own (co-host also requires
`cohost.assign`; OWNER is never granted). Optionally send the participant's `version` for
optimistic concurrency; media permissions of connected sessions follow the new role.

post.summary: Lock the participant's future screen sharing (persistent, provider-enforced).
post.description: Stops an admitted participant from starting a screen share until the lock is removed (to end a share already in progress, use the stop-screen-share operation); the lock is stored on the participant and enforced by the media provider (see `providerEnforcement`). The caller needs the matching media-control permission and may only target a less privileged participant, never themselves. Repeating the call is a no-op that returns `changed: false`.

delete.summary: Unlock the participant's future screen sharing (grants recomputed from role + policy).
delete.description: Removes the lock so the participant may share again; the participant's effective publication rights are then recomputed from their role and the conference policy and returned in `permissions`. Same permission and target rules as locking; repeating the call returns `changed: false`.

post.summary: Lock the participant's camera (persistent, provider-enforced).
post.description: Stops an admitted participant from publishing their camera until the lock is removed; the lock is stored on the participant and enforced by the media provider (see `providerEnforcement`). The caller needs the matching media-control permission and may only target a less privileged participant, never themselves. Repeating the call is a no-op that returns `changed: false`.

delete.summary: Unlock the participant's camera (grants recomputed from role + policy).
delete.description: Removes the lock; the participant's effective publication rights are then recomputed from their role and the conference policy and returned in `permissions`. Same permission and target rules as locking; repeating the call returns `changed: false`.

get.summary: Polls of a conference (drafts for poll managers only; quiz answers protected).
get.description:
Returns up to 200 polls of the conference, oldest first, each with its response count and
whether the caller has responded. DRAFT polls are included only for callers who can create or
manage polls, and quiz correct answers are hidden from attendees until the results state allows
them. The caller must be a participant or member of the conference (bearer user token or
participant token).

post.summary: Create a poll or quiz (DRAFT).
post.description:
Creates a poll (or a scored quiz when `quizMode` is true) in DRAFT state; open it with
`POST .../open`. Requires the poll-create permission (host, co-host or moderator by default),
polls enabled for the meeting and a conference that is not ended or cancelled. Title is 1–300
characters; `resultsVisibility` defaults to AFTER_CLOSE. Accepts a bearer user token or a
participant token.

get.summary: One poll.
get.description:
Returns a single poll of the conference with its questions, status, response count and whether
the caller has responded. A DRAFT poll is reported as POLL_NOT_FOUND to callers who cannot
create or manage polls, and quiz correct answers are hidden until the results state allows them.
Accepts a bearer user token or a participant token.

post.summary: Archive a closed poll or cancel a draft (CLOSED or DRAFT → ARCHIVED).
post.description: Removes the poll from active use. Requires the poll-close permission. Repeating the call on an archived poll returns `changed: false`; any other transition returns 409.

post.summary: Close an open poll (OPEN → CLOSED; never reopened).
post.description: Stops accepting responses. A closed poll is never reopened. Requires the poll-close permission. Repeating the call on a closed poll returns `changed: false`; any other transition returns 409.

post.summary: Open a draft poll for responses (DRAFT → OPEN).
post.description: Starts collecting responses. Allowed only from DRAFT, on a LIVE conference with polls enabled, for a caller with the poll-open permission. Repeating the call on an open poll returns `changed: false`; any other transition returns 409.

post.summary: Submit the caller's own response (one ballot per participant).
post.description:
Records the caller's answers to an OPEN poll while the conference is LIVE. The caller must be an
admitted participant with permission to answer polls; each participant gets exactly one ballot
and a second ballot fails with POLL_ALREADY_RESPONDED. Retrying with the same `idempotencyKey`
returns 200 with `idempotentReplay: true` instead; a new ballot returns 201. Quizzes are scored
server-side, and the score is returned only for non-anonymous AFTER_VOTE quizzes; anonymous
ballots are stored without the participant's identity. Rate-limited per participant.

get.summary: Aggregate results, subject to the poll's visibility mode.
get.description:
Returns aggregated results of a poll. Poll managers can read them at any time; other callers
only as the visibility mode allows (HOST_ONLY: never; AFTER_VOTE: once they have voted or the
poll is closed; AFTER_CLOSE: once closed), otherwise POLL_RESULTS_NOT_VISIBLE. Results of
anonymous polls are available to everyone, managers included, only once the poll is closed.
Accepts a bearer user token or a participant token.

get.summary: Pre-join contract: everything a pre-join screen needs before the media join.
get.description:
Returns the conference status and whether it can be joined now, this caller's access
requirements (sign-in, invitation, passcode, external authorization, expected waiting room),
recording/transcription/AI notices, consents to grant when joining, the role and media
permissions the caller would get, and display-name rules. Works without authentication; for
sensitive meetings the title and organization are hidden until the caller is authorized.

post.summary: CREATED → PREPARING → (provider room confirmed) → WAITING.
post.description:
Prepares a CREATED conference: it moves to PREPARING, the media room is requested from the RTC
provider, and it becomes WAITING once the provider confirms the room. Requires
`conference.start`. Calling it on a PREPARING or WAITING conference is a no-op that may retry
provider confirmation; `providerEnforcement` is PENDING_PROVIDER_CONTROL while the room is not
yet confirmed.

get.summary: Conference quality summary for holders of `quality.view`.
get.description: The summary contains no infrastructure identifiers.

post.summary: Submit a batch of technical quality samples for the caller's own session.
post.description:
Identity, conference and session are server-derived; bodies are size- and rate-limited and
contain no free text.

get.summary: Questions (pinned first, then by upvotes).
get.description:
Returns up to 1000 questions of the conference, ordered pinned first, then by upvote count, then
oldest first, with `votedByMe` and `isMine` for the caller. Attendees see OPEN and ANSWERED
questions; Q&A moderators also see DISMISSED and ARCHIVED ones. Anonymous questions never
include the author. Accepts a bearer user token or a participant token.

post.summary: Ask a question (optionally anonymous).
post.description:
Submits a new OPEN question to the conference Q&A. The caller must be an admitted participant
allowed to ask questions, the conference must be LIVE and Q&A enabled; the body is 1–1000
characters. `anonymous: true` is accepted only when the meeting allows anonymous questions, and
the author's identity is then never returned to hosts or other participants. Rate-limited per
participant.

post.summary: Answer a question (first committed answer wins).
post.description:
Marks an OPEN question as ANSWERED, with an optional written `answer` (omit it when answered
live). Requires the Q&A answer permission (host, co-host or moderator by default) and a
conference that is not ended or cancelled. Answering an already-answered question keeps the
first answer and returns `changed: false`; dismissed or archived questions return
CONFERENCE_STATE_CONFLICT.

post.summary: Archive a question.
post.description:
Moves a question in any state to ARCHIVED and unpins it, hiding it from attendees. Requires the
Q&A dismiss permission (host, co-host or moderator by default) and a conference that is not
ended or cancelled. Archiving an already-archived question returns `changed: false`.

post.summary: Dismiss a question.
post.description:
Moves an OPEN or ANSWERED question to DISMISSED and unpins it, hiding it from attendees.
Requires the Q&A dismiss permission (host, co-host or moderator by default) and a conference
that is not ended or cancelled. Dismissing an already-dismissed question returns
`changed: false`; an archived question returns CONFERENCE_STATE_CONFLICT.

post.summary: Pin a question.
post.description:
Pins an OPEN or ANSWERED question so it is listed first. Requires the Q&A pin permission (host,
co-host or moderator by default) and a conference that is not ended or cancelled. Pinning an
already-pinned question returns `changed: false`; dismissed or archived questions cannot be
pinned (CONFERENCE_STATE_CONFLICT).

delete.description:
Removes the pin from a question. Requires the Q&A pin permission (host, co-host or moderator by
default) and a conference that is not ended or cancelled. Unpinning a question that is not
pinned returns `changed: false`.

post.summary: Upvote a question (idempotent).
post.description:
Adds the caller's upvote to an OPEN or ANSWERED question while the conference is LIVE and Q&A is
enabled; the caller must be an admitted participant and cannot upvote their own question. Voting
again is a no-op that returns `changed: false`. The upvote count is recalculated from the stored
votes. Rate-limited per participant.

delete.description:
Removes the caller's upvote from a question while the conference is LIVE and Q&A is enabled; the
caller must be an admitted participant. Returns `changed: false` when the caller had not voted.
Rate-limited per participant.

post.summary: Send a transient reaction (no stored row).
post.description:
Broadcasts a reaction key (e.g. `thumbs_up`, `clap`) from the caller to everyone in the same
room (main room or the caller's breakout). Requires an admitted participant with `reaction.send`
in a LIVE conference, with reactions enabled and the key allowed by the meeting policy; rate
limited. Nothing is stored; `delivered` is false when the realtime channel was unavailable.

get.summary: WebSocket conference event stream.
get.description:
Upgrades to a WebSocket that streams conference events as JSON frames (`subscribed`, `event`,
`degraded`, `resync_required`, `revoked`, `closed`, `pong`). Authenticate with a `ticket` from
the ticket endpoint or with the usual bearer / participant-token headers, and pass `cursor` to
replay missed events first. Access is re-checked during the connection, which closes when access
is revoked or the conference ends; send the text `ping` to receive a `pong`.

400.description: VALIDATION_ERROR (not a WebSocket upgrade / invalid query)

post.summary: Mint a one-shot realtime subscription ticket.
post.description:
Browser WebSockets cannot send auth headers, so clients call this with their bearer or
participant token and pass the returned `ticket` as a query parameter when opening the realtime
WebSocket. The ticket is bound to this conference and expires after 60 seconds. The response
also gives the current event `cursor` and the caller's `scope`: FULL, or SELF_ONLY for a
participant still in the waiting room.

get.summary: Recordings of a conference.
get.description:
Lists the conference's recordings with their lifecycle status, newest first (at most 100).
Requires authority in the conference plus the artifact-list permission or permission to start or
stop recording.

post.summary: Start the composite recording (provider called only after REQUESTED commits).
post.description:
Starts the conference's single composite recording. The conference must be LIVE, the caller
needs the recording-start permission, the meeting policy must allow recording, and where policy
requires explicit consent every affected participant must have consented. Returns 202 with the
recording in REQUESTED state (it becomes RECORDING only once the provider confirms capture);
repeating a request with the same `idempotencyKey` returns the existing recording with 200.

get.summary: One recording (scoped to the conference).
get.description:
Returns one recording with its current lifecycle status; the recording must belong to the given
conference. The same permissions as listing recordings apply. Use the artifact `access` endpoint
to obtain a download link.

post.summary: Stop a recording (idempotent).
post.description:
Stops an active recording; repeating the call is safe. The recording becomes `READY` only
after the media provider has finalized it and its stored file has been verified.

post.summary: Reschedule one unstarted occurrence (series untouched).
post.description:
Sets a new `scheduledStartAt` (required; more than 5 minutes in the past is rejected) for a
conference still in state CREATED; any other state returns CONFERENCE_STATE_CONFLICT. An omitted
`scheduledEndAt` keeps the occurrence's duration (the end is never cleared); an explicit one must
be after the start and at most 24 hours later. An optional `version` guards against concurrent
changes (MEETING_VERSION_CONFLICT). Requires a bearer user token whose role holds
`conference.start`. For an occurrence of a recurring series only that occurrence moves.

post.summary: STOP SHARE NOW: terminate a participant's active screen share (not a lock).
post.description:
Ends the participant's current screen share through the RTC provider without blocking future
shares (use the screen-share lock for that). You may stop your own share; stopping someone
else's requires `participant.screen_share_stop` and a target less privileged than you. The
conference must be LIVE and the participant sharing; success is returned only after the provider
confirms.

post.summary: Spotlight a participant (shared presentation metadata; personal pins stay client-side).
post.description:
Adds an ADMITTED participant to the spotlight shown to everyone; media permissions are not
changed. Requires `participant.spotlight` and a LIVE conference. If the meeting allows a single
spotlight the new one replaces the previous one; otherwise going over the policy's maximum
returns VALIDATION_ERROR. Returns the current spotlights (`changed: false` if already
spotlighted).

delete.description:
Removes the participant from the shared spotlight. Requires `participant.spotlight` and a LIVE
conference. Returns the remaining spotlights; `changed` is false if the participant was not
spotlighted.

post.summary: Start a conference. Concurrent starts yield exactly one LIVE authority.
post.description:
Moves a CREATED, PREPARING or WAITING conference to LIVE (a CREATED one is prepared first).
Requires `conference.start`, an active meeting space, and the current time within the start
window (from the space's early-start allowance before the scheduled start until its grace period
after the scheduled end). Starting a LIVE conference is a no-op (`changed: false`), and only one
conference per meeting space can be LIVE at a time.

post.summary: Start LIVE or POST_MEETING transcription (policy, location and consent gated).
post.description:
Creates a transcription job whose output becomes a transcript artifact. LIVE (the default)
requires a live conference; POST_MEETING transcribes the READY recording given in
`sourceRecordingId`. Requires the transcription-start permission, a meeting policy and provider
location that allow it, and participant consent where policy requires it. `language` defaults to
`en`.

post.summary: Stop a transcription job.
post.description:
Requests that an active transcription job stop and returns the job. Requires the
transcription-stop permission. Calling it on a job that is no longer active returns the job
unchanged.

get.summary: Transcription jobs / transcripts of a conference.
get.description:
Lists the conference's transcription jobs, newest first (at most 100), with their mode, status,
language, segment count and transcript artifact id. Requires the transcript-read permission.

get.summary: Transcript FINAL segments (cursor paginated).
get.description:
Returns the transcript artifact, its job and a page of FINAL segments in sequence order.
Requires the transcript-read permission. Page with `after` (last sequence seen) and `limit`
(default 200, max 1000); `nextAfter` is set while more segments remain.

post.summary: Translate a READY transcript (downstream; the original is never overwritten).
post.description:
Translates every segment of a READY transcript into `targetLanguage` and stores the translations
alongside the original. Requires both the transcript-read and transcription-start permissions,
and the translation provider must be permitted by the meeting's location policy. Segments
already translated into that language are not duplicated.

post.summary: Unlock a live conference.
post.description:
Lifts the lock so new entrants can join again under the normal access and waiting-room rules.
Requires `conference.lock` and a LIVE conference (CONFERENCE_NOT_LIVE otherwise). Unlocking a
conference that is not locked is a no-op (`changed: false`).

get.summary: Waiting queue (requires `participant.admit`).
get.description:
Returns the participants currently WAITING for admission, oldest request first. The caller's
conference role (from an admitted participant or a space membership) must hold
`participant.admit`. Returns FEATURE_DISABLED when the waiting room is not enabled.

post.summary: Admit one, selected or all waiting participants (transactional, idempotent).
post.description:
Moves WAITING participants to ADMITTED: pass `participantIds` (up to 500) or `all: true` for
everyone currently waiting. Requires `participant.admit` and a LIVE conference, and respects the
meeting's capacity. Any id outside this conference fails the whole request; already admitted ids
are reported as `unchanged`, and banned or otherwise ineligible ones as `skipped`.

post.summary: Deny one, selected or all waiting participants.
post.description:
Moves WAITING participants to DENIED: pass `participantIds` (up to 500) or `all: true`. Optional
`reasonCode` (max 64 chars) and `message` (max 500 chars, shown to the denied participant), plus
an `internalNote` that is never shown to them. Requires `participant.deny`; any id outside this
conference fails the whole request, already denied ids are `unchanged` and others `skipped`.

post.summary: Instant meeting: creates a meeting space and a LIVE conference atomically.
post.description:
Creates a meeting space owned by the caller and a conference that is LIVE immediately, in one
step, and returns both. The body is optional: the title defaults to "Instant meeting" and the
access policy to PUBLIC; timezone, waiting-room policy and passcode may be set. Requires a
signed-in user with v2 meetings enabled for the account. The conference's media room is prepared
right away on a best-effort basis.

post.summary: Resolve an invitation token (read-only; does not consume a use).
post.description:
Public endpoint, no authentication required. Returns the meeting space the token belongs to, the
conference it is limited to (if any), the role it grants, its expiry and remaining uses.
Unknown, revoked or used-up tokens return INVITATION_INVALID and expired ones
INVITATION_EXPIRED; a use is consumed only when the token is used to join a conference.

get.summary: List the caller's occurrences across meeting spaces (agenda / calendar range).
get.description:
Returns scheduled occurrences whose start lies in `[from, to)` (default: the next 31 days;
at most 366 days), ordered by start, across every meeting space the caller owns, is an
active member of, holds an active invitation for (bound to the caller's verified email),
is registered for, or took part in. A machine caller gets its own environment's meetings.
Recurring occurrences beyond the 30-day materialization horizon are included with
`materialized: false` and `conferenceId: null`; `occurrenceKey` is stable, so the entry keeps
its identity once the occurrence is materialized. Filters: `status` and `role` (the caller's
relation: OWNER, MEMBER, INVITEE, REGISTRANT, PARTICIPANT, ORGANIZATION), both
comma-separated. `organizationId` restricts the agenda to that organization and adds its
organization-visible meetings; the caller must be a verified member, and an unknown or
unauthorized organization gets the same PERMISSION_DENIED. Paginate with `limit` (1-200,
default 50) and the opaque `nextCursor`. Only managers of a space (FULL view) see
management detail; titles of HEALTHCARE / HIGH_SECURITY spaces are omitted otherwise.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: RFC 3339, exclusive (default from + 31 days, at most 366 days)

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: Organization of which the caller is a verified member

get.summary: Organizations the caller verifiably belongs to.
get.description:
Returns the organizations in which the signed-in user has an active, directory-verified
membership, each with the user's role. Requires a user bearer token. Once the Organizations
Service is authoritative the list comes from it (active, non-GUEST memberships of active
organizations) and each item also carries `organizationRole`.

get.summary: Get my profile
get.description:
Returns the signed-in account's profile: username, display name, avatar reference, time
zone, locale, email verification and the canonical account status. The Account is the
authority for these fields; the Communications profile shows the same display name and
avatar. Phone verification is not available yet (`PROVIDER_BLOCKED`, never required).

patch.description:
Changes any of username, display name, avatar reference, time zone and locale (send only
the fields to change; `null` clears an optional field). The same rules apply as at
registration and on `PATCH /api/v1/users/me`. Returns the updated profile. A username that
belongs to another account answers `409 USERNAME_TAKEN`.

get.summary: List my sessions
get.description:
Lists the signed-in user's account sessions (one per sign-in), newest first, marking the
session this request was made with as `current`. Sessions last at most 30 days.

parameters.name: includeEnded
parameters.description: Also return revoked and expired sessions (most recent 100 in total).

post.summary: Sign out everywhere
post.description:
Ends every session of the signed-in user, including the current one, and every token issued
before sessions existed. Connected CF Meet services are told through the account's durable
revocation events. Sign in again afterwards.

post.summary: Sign out one session
post.description:
Ends one of the signed-in user's sessions (for example a lost device): its access and refresh
tokens stop working immediately on every CF Meet service that checks account sessions, and
everything that sign-in holds ends with it: its MANAGED-realtime session devices and the
Communications devices it linked (Messaging device, push registration, Calling endpoint).
Unknown or foreign session ids get the same 404.

get.summary: List the caller's workspaces (Personal and organizations).
get.description:
Returns the caller's workspace contexts: `personal` first, then every organization in which
the caller holds an ACTIVE membership, ordered by id, each with the caller's role, the
organization's status (a SUSPENDED organization is listed and grants nothing), its
provisioning state and a small capability summary. Workspace context is per request: the
server stores no active organization, so organization-scoped calls keep naming their
organization. Once the Organizations Service is authoritative the list comes from it (all
roles, including GUEST; capabilities under the organization policy); before that it comes
from the meeting-service organization directory with the rule of `GET
/api/v2/me/organizations` and `provisioningState` is null. Paginate with `limit` (1-200,
default 50) and the opaque `nextCursor`.

503.description: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE (Organizations unreachable; never a partial list)

get.summary: Capabilities of one workspace, derived by the server.
get.description:
Returns the features and every capability decision (granted, and why not:
CAPABILITY_NOT_GRANTED, POLICY_RESTRICTED, ORGANIZATION_SUSPENDED or FEATURE_DISABLED) for the
caller in `workspaceId` — `personal`, or an organization id from `GET /api/v2/me/workspaces`.
Computed on every request from the organization authority (role matrix and effective
organization policy once the Organizations Service is authoritative); owner services still
re-verify each operation. Unknown organizations, organizations the caller is not an ACTIVE
member of and malformed ids all answer ORGANIZATION_NOT_FOUND. Personal communications
capabilities stay with the Communications Hub (`personalCommunicationsCapabilities`).

get.summary: List meeting spaces the caller owns or is a member of.
get.description:
Returns every non-deleted meeting space the signed-in caller owns or is an active member of,
newest first; archived spaces are included. Each item carries the caller's role and its
canonical conference (the LIVE one, else the next unstarted one whose start window is still
open, else the latest). Owners, hosts and co-hosts get the full view, other members the summary
view. Without `limit` and `cursor` the complete list is returned (legacy behaviour); with
either, one page of `limit` (1-200, default 50) items and `nextCursor` while more exist.

post.summary: Create a meeting space. The owner is always the authenticated caller.
post.description:
Creates an ACTIVE meeting space with a newly generated meeting code; any owner sent by the
client is ignored. Requires a signed-in user with v2 meetings enabled for the account
(FEATURE_DISABLED otherwise). An `organizationId` is accepted only if the caller is a verified
member of that organization, and an optional passcode is validated and stored only as a hash. No
conference is created; schedule one separately or use `POST /api/v2/instant-meetings`. Send an
`Idempotency-Key` header (1-128 visible ASCII characters, kept 24 hours per caller) to make
retries safe: a retry with the same key and body returns the same space (header
`Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different body is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional retry key (1-128 visible ASCII characters)

201.description: Created (or replayed for the same Idempotency-Key)

get.summary: Read a meeting space by v2 id, v2 meeting code, legacy meeting id or legacy code.
get.description:
Callers without management rights receive the SUMMARY view; resolution never implies
authorization.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Space UUID, meeting code, legacy meeting UUID or legacy code

patch.summary: Update a meeting space (optimistic concurrency via `version`).
patch.description:
Partially updates the space's settings and policies; omitted fields are left unchanged. Requires
the owner or a host, v2 meetings enabled for the account, and the space's current `version` (a
stale version returns MEETING_VERSION_CONFLICT). Archived spaces cannot be modified. A passcode
can be set or cleared with `clearPasscode`; changing the timezone re-anchors an active
recurrence to the new timezone at the same wall-clock time. Ownership cannot be changed here;
use the owner-transfer endpoint.

post.summary: Soft-archive a meeting space (owner only). History is preserved.
post.description:
Archives the space: it can no longer be modified, its recurring series is ended and unstarted
future occurrences are cancelled, while past conferences, participants and audit history are
kept. Only the owner (or a platform administrator) may archive. The optional body `version` is
checked against the current version (MEETING_VERSION_CONFLICT on mismatch). Archiving an
already-archived space returns it unchanged.

get.summary: Export a meeting space's schedule as an iCalendar (RFC 5545) file.
get.description:
The active recurring series as one VEVENT with RRULE (UNTIL in UTC), EXDATE for cancelled
occurrences and RECURRENCE-ID overrides for rescheduled ones, all in the meeting timezone with
a generated VTIMEZONE; plus the space's one-off scheduled occurrences (up to 200, from 90 days
ago; cancelled ones with STATUS:CANCELLED). UIDs are stable per series / occurrence and
SEQUENCE increases on every change. Allowed for the space owner and members, holders of an
active space invitation bound to their verified email, webinar registrants and the owning
machine caller. No passcodes, invitation tokens or provider identifiers. Served with
`Cache-Control: no-store`.

get.summary: List occurrences of a meeting space (members only).
get.description:
Returns the conferences of the meeting space (full view), ordered by scheduled start. Optional
`from` (inclusive) and `to` (exclusive) RFC 3339 timestamps filter on the scheduled start time.
Requires a bearer user token of the space owner or an active member.

post.summary: Create a one-time scheduled conference occurrence.
post.description:
Adds a single (non-recurring) conference to an active meeting space in state CREATED, with
optional `scheduledStartAt` / `scheduledEndAt` (the end requires a start, must be after it and
at most 24 hours later; a start more than 5 minutes in the past is rejected). Requires a bearer
user token whose space role may schedule conferences. Send an `Idempotency-Key` header (1-128
visible ASCII characters, kept 24 hours per caller and space) to make retries safe: the same
key and body return the same conference (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key
with a different body is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional retry key (1-128 visible ASCII characters)

201.description: Created (or replayed for the same Idempotency-Key)

post.summary: Duplicate reusable configuration into a new space owned by the caller.
post.description:
Creates a new ACTIVE space with a new meeting code, owned by the caller, copying the source
space's settings and policies, including its passcode. Conferences, members, invitations,
history and recordings are not copied. Requires the owner or a host of the source space and v2
meetings enabled for the account. The title defaults to "Copy of " plus the source title; the
organization is dropped if the caller is not a verified member of it.

get.summary: List invitations of a space (no tokens or hashes).
get.description:
Returns all invitations of the meeting space, newest first, including revoked and expired ones,
with their status and usage count. Requires a bearer user token with invite authority in the
space (a role allowed to admit participants).

post.summary: Create an invitation. The raw token is returned once and never stored.
post.description:
Issues a bearer invitation for an active meeting space, optionally limited to one conference
(`conferenceId`), bound to a verified account email (`inviteeEmail`) or capped by `useLimit`
(1–10000). It expires after `expiresInHours` (default 168, capped by server policy) and grants
`role` (default PARTICIPANT), which must be below the inviter's own role. Requires a bearer user
token with invite authority in the space (a role allowed to admit participants); store the token
from the response, it cannot be retrieved again. With `sendEmail: true` (requires `inviteeEmail`)
the link is also emailed to the invitee when notification email is enabled on the deployment;
`emailDelivery` reports the outcome and at most a configured number of invitation emails per
hour can be requested (`429 RATE_LIMITED`). Machine callers cannot request emails.

post.summary: Revoke an invitation.
post.description:
Marks the invitation REVOKED so it can no longer be resolved or used to join. Requires a bearer
user token with invite authority in the space (a role allowed to admit participants). Revoking
an already revoked invitation is a no-op that returns it unchanged.

get.summary: List members (owner / host / co-host members).
get.description:
Returns every membership of the meeting space (active and revoked), oldest first. Requires a
bearer user token; only the space owner, hosts and co-hosts may view members.

post.summary: Add a member. The granted role is bounded by the caller's grant authority.
post.description:
Grants a persistent membership in an active meeting space to either a registered user (`userId`)
or an email address (`email`); provide exactly one. Only the owner or a host may add members,
and the role must be below the caller's own (assigning co-host also requires `cohost.assign`).
You cannot add yourself or the owner, and a principal can hold only one active membership.

delete.description:
Marks the membership REVOKED and returns it; the record is kept. Only the owner or a host may
revoke, and only members less privileged than themselves (or their own membership). Revoking an
already revoked membership is a no-op that returns it unchanged.

patch.description:
Changes the role of an active membership. Send the member's current `version`; a stale version
returns MEETING_VERSION_CONFLICT. Only the owner or a host may change roles, only for members
less privileged than themselves and never their own, and the new role must be below the caller's
own (co-host also requires `cohost.assign`).

post.summary: Transfer ownership (dedicated, protected operation).
post.description:
Makes another active registered (non-guest) user the owner of an active space. Only the current
owner (or a platform administrator) may transfer, and the request must carry the space's current
`version`. The new owner's existing membership is replaced by ownership. The previous owner
stays on as a HOST member unless `retainPreviousOwner` is false.

get.summary: Stored space override plus the effective (resolved, clamped) meeting profile.
get.description:
Returns the space's sparse profile override as stored, its `profilePolicyVersion` (send it back
when updating) and the effective meeting profile after organization and security limits are
applied, including which fields were clamped. Requires a signed-in owner, host or co-host of the
space.

patch.summary: Update the space's sparse profile override (cannot exceed org / security ceilings).
patch.description:
Merges `changes` into the space's stored profile override and returns the new override and
effective profile. Requires a signed-in owner or host, and `profilePolicyVersion` must match the
current version (MEETING_VERSION_CONFLICT otherwise). Unknown keys are rejected, and a change
that would disallow public access while the space's access policy is public is refused with
PROFILE_POLICY_DENIED. Live conferences of the space are notified, and recording or
transcription that the new policy no longer allows is stopped (nothing is deleted).

get.summary: Read the active recurrence rule.
get.description:
Returns the space's active recurrence rule (RRULE, timezone, start and duration), or 404 if the
space has no active recurrence. The caller must be a signed-in owner or member of the space.

put.summary: Create or edit the space's recurrence (RFC 5545 RRULE in the space timezone).
put.description:
